[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-66[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Idle Pomodoro agenda: an empty Bob Mac Capture panel shows the [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]running Pomodoro and everything queued after it[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]When the capture panel opens with an empty draft, it already shows [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]today's agenda, painted from memory in the first frame: the running[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pomodoro and every future Pomodoro, each with its linked tasks at [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the most detail that fits below a fixed eye line without scrolling.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The `=x` and `=` numbers match the ones bob will use. Detail folds [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]per Pomodoro, farthest first: logs, then one-line tasks, then one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]row per Pomodoro, then a name strip. bob owns every fact; the app [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]owns caching, fitting, and pixels.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob capture-pomodoros --tasks returns the resolved agenda[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli-agenda[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli-agenda: add the additive `-t/--tasks` flag to `bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-pomodoros`. It returns roles, role-specific operator numbers, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolved Task Links with clean titles, statuses, and log-tagged block [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lines, plus ledger notes, session notes, retired counts, the date, and a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]completed summary. One memoized pass, deterministic bytes, colored human[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]output, docs, golden fixtures, and a read-count perf gate.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Agenda JSON models, client call, fake-bob branch, and fixtures[bold black on #87D7FF][/bold #D7AFFF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]mac-agenda-models[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli-agenda[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-agenda-models: add the CaptureCore `CaptureAgendaSnapshot` decoders [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](decodeIfPresent everywhere), [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`BobProcessClient.captureAgenda(previous:)` with a byte-compare short [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]circuit and old-bob detection, a fake-bob `--tasks` branch, and fixtures[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]copied from bob-cli goldens, all with tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]In-memory agenda store, refresh triggers, path-filtered [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]watcher, count from snapshot[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]mac-agenda-store[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-agenda-models[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-agenda-store: add the pure refresh state machine and relevance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]filter in CaptureCore, and the @MainActor `CaptureAgendaStore` that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refreshes on launch, filtered vault events, show, submit, wake, unlock, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and midnight. It replaces the per-show capture-pomodoros spawn, derives [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the close-comma count from the snapshot, passes FSEvents paths through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the watcher, and falls back for an old bob.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Agenda presentation, inline text, and the focus-gradient fit [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]planner[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]mac-agenda-planner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mac-agenda-models[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-agenda-planner: add the pure CaptureCore `CaptureAgendaPresentation`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](groups, rows, row keys, duplicates, chips, strings), [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`CaptureAgendaInlineText`, `CaptureAgendaLayoutMetrics`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`CaptureAgendaBudget`, the countdown wording, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`CaptureAgendaFitPlanner` (the seven-step farthest-first ladder with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]manual expansions). Table-driven tests run on Linux.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Agenda view, row measurer, panel integration, and fixed eye [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]line[/bold #D7AFFF]

    [#D7D7AF]mac-agenda-view: build `CaptureAgendaView` and its row views, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]offscreen `CaptureAgendaRowMeasurer`, model wiring (visibility, plan, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]expansions, settle while hidden), auxiliary-region integration with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]height cap, fixed eye-line placement instead of re-centring, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Settings toggle. Add height-consistency and rendered design tests, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]checked from the CI artifact.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Transitions, countdown, stale and error states, accessibility,[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
